why: The over-correction on the other side of the announcement: the latch is read but never spent, so the FIRST level switch of a session wipes the board on that frame and on every frame after it. Tread trails then look simply broken -- a tank prints one pair and it is gone by the next sync -- while every 'the board is empty after the switch' assertion in the file still passes, since they all stop syncing within a frame or two of the clear.
killedBy: tread trails: round boundary and level switch spends the announcement on one sync and keeps printing afterwards
